understanding: Abdominal ultrasound teaching video showing equipment and synchronized probe placement and sonograms for several organs.

tasks.question: Where is the brightest irregular tissue within the kidney in this view?
tasks.reference_answer: It is near the center of the kidney, surrounded by a darker rim.
